SELECT a.number, a.name, b.seq FROM t_sys_app a INNER JOIN t_sys_user_app_pin b ON b.app_id = a.id INNER JOIN t_sys_domain c ON c.id = a.domain_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND a.enabled = true AND c.enabled = true
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_sys_menu d INNER JOIN t_sys_role_perms e ON e.permission_id = d.permission_id INNER JOIN t_sys_user_role f ON f.role_id = e.role_id WHERE d.app_id = a.id AND d.enabled = true AND f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.org_id = #{orgId} )
ORDER BY b.seq, b.id
SELECT a.id FROM t_sys_user a WHERE a.id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
